title: landlord_deleted_my_parkour_room
display_title: My Landlord Made Me Sign a 'No Gaming' Clause Over a Webcam Mic
beats: My landlord added a clause to my lease banning 'loud gaming noises' after hearing me celebrate a personal best through the wall.
I run a small Minecraft parkour channel, 41 subscribers, and that scream was for a jump I'd failed 300 times.
She gave me 10 days to remove my setup or face a $200 monthly 'noise fee,' in writing, notarized.
So I went quiet. Dead quiet. No mic, no yelling, just me clicking keys at 2 a.m. for a week straight.
Then I uploaded the run where I finally land it in total silence, subtitled, and tagged the video 'landlord-approved.'
It hit 400,000 views, someone recognized her building in a corner of my webcam reflection, and now she's the one getting noise complaints from strangers at her door asking for a tour. Was I wrong?
